goal: Tidy the desk: put the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on its stand (cube cushion), put the mouse on the mouse pad, push the keyboard into the frame, and return both arms to their start pose.
instruction_templates: Place the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on the stand, place the mouse on the mouse pad, and push the keyboard into the frame.
success: All four item groups hold at the same action boundary, plus the arms-back condition. Each item's first check, is_not_moved(update=True), means the item moved less than 0.002 m (3-D) since this check was last evaluated (the previous action boundary at which evaluation reached it) -- i.e. the item is at rest.

mouse: not moved (<0.002 m); mouse origin in mousemat (is_A_in_B: origin xy inside the mousemat bbox hull, origin z > mousemat bbox z_min); mouse local +y axis within 45 deg of world +x (3-D angle; one direction only).

keyboard: not moved (<0.002 m); keyboard's world-projected bbox footprint covers the whole rectangle x in [0.0, 0.2], y in [-0.03, 0.03] (world/table coordinates; the frame is at (0.10, 0.0)) with 1e-6 m tolerance (is_A_bbox_cover_rect_region; code unpacks rect_bounds as [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]); keyboard local +y within 45 deg of world +y; keyboard local z within 15 deg of world up (default).

garage (the figurine): not moved (<0.002 m); 0.005 m < (garage origin z - cube_cushion origin z) < 0.1 m (is_A_up_B); garage local z within 15 deg of world up; garage origin and cube_cushion origin within L metres in xy, where L depends on the figurine model index: {5: 0.045, 6: 0.025, 7: 0.045, 8: 0.02, 11: 0.032}, default 0.02.
alarm: not moved (<0.002 m); 0.225 m < (alarm origin z - drawer origin z) < 0.3 m; alarm local z within 15 deg of world up. (No xy requirement relative to the drawer is coded.)

all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, at the same action boundary as all other conditions. Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
evaluation: All listed conditions are checked together, in order, after every action (reward_manager.step runs once per action, after the action's whole control sequence has executed; nothing is checked between actions). They form a single stage: all must be true at the same action boundary (any list inside the conditions means 'at least one of'). Success is declared at the first action boundary where all hold; the episode then ends. No final_check list is used. Otherwise the episode ends as a failure after step_lim actions. Because the 'not moved' checks compare with the previous evaluation and the list is short-circuited in order (mouse, keyboard, garage, alarm, back-to-origin), all four items must be stationary and in place simultaneously; an item's stationarity is only measured on actions where all earlier checks passed. No early-fail rule.
objects: mouse: computer mouse (category mouse idx 4,6,7), 1, x in [0,0.45], y in [-0.3,0.05] (table frame), yaw up to +-45 deg
alarm: alarm clock (category alarm), 1, x in [-0.45,0], y in [-0.3,0.05], no yaw randomness
keyboard: keyboard (category keyboard), 1, x in [-0.05,0.05], y in [-0.2,-0.15], no yaw randomness
garage: a garage-kit figurine (category garage idx 5,6,7,8,11), 1, x in [-0.45,0], y in [-0.3,0.05], yaw up to +-45 deg, place_tag 'up'
drawer: static drawer unit (category drawer), x in [-0.45,-0.25], y=0.15
cube_cushion: figurine stand (category cube_cushion idx 2), fixed at (-0.15, 0.1)
mousemat: mouse pad (category mousemat), x in [0.35,0.5], y in [-0.1,0.05]
frame: keyboard frame (category frame), fixed at (0.10, 0.0), enforced placement
monitor: static monitor (category monitor), x in [-0.05,0.15], y in [0.2,0.25]; prohibited spawn area x[-0.15,0.15], y[-0.32,-0.27]
needs_memory_or_language: none (instruction names the four items; the figurine is the 'garage' object and the stand is the cube_cushion).
end_requirements: all_robot_back_to_origin(): every agent-controlled (target) arm's end-effector must be within 0.15 m on EACH of x, y, z (per-axis) and within 20 degrees of its pose at the start of the episode, (part of the success condition). Grippers are NOT required to be open by the success test (only by partial-credit scoring).
physics_kind: rigid (drawer, monitor, mousemat, frame, cushion are static geometry)
notes: The garage xy tolerance is only 2-4.5 cm and is checked on origins (not bboxes). The alarm only needs to be 0.225-0.3 m above the drawer's origin z, so the exact xy placement relative to the drawer is not tested. The keyboard must fully cover the 0.2 x 0.06 m region: the keyboard must be pushed to the frame location (x 0-0.2, around y=0) with its long side (local y within 45 deg of world y). The mouse condition uses 3-D angle to world +x, not projected. The 'not moved' test returns 'moved' on the first evaluation of each item if it has moved since episode start, then re-arms, so each item effectively needs two consecutive evaluated actions at rest. Predicate conventions (from func_parser.py): object 'position' = the object's root/origin position in world coordinates (metres, z up); 'bbox' = the 8 corners of the object's local bounding box transformed to world; is_A_in_B = A's origin xy lies inside the convex hull of B's world-projected bbox AND A's origin z > B's bbox z_min; is_axis_up(label, axis, threshold) = angle between (object rotation applied to the local axis) and world +z is < threshold degrees (wrapper default threshold 15 deg); is_axis_aligned = angle between two (optionally functional-point-frame) axes < align_threshold degrees, optionally after projection onto a plane (project_plane='xy' drops z and renormalises); all_robot_back_to_origin() default = for every target (agent-controlled) arm, end-effector pose vs its pose at episode start: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m (per-axis, not Euclidean) and orientation difference <= 20 deg; is_all_gripper_open(open_threshold) = every target gripper's normalised opening ((val-scale0)/(scale1-scale0)) >= open_threshold (wrapper default 0.6).
